description: Creates per-store product discounts (POST /b2b/v1/discounts/create), at most 100 per request. CAUTION: the exact key names inside discount_activity_period and discount_value are NOT documented (the official client types them as plain string→string maps with no example) — confirm the expected keys with Yango Tech before relying on this tool, and note there is no endpoint to list or delete discounts. The response body is not documented upstream (2xx = success) and is returned verbatim.

discounts.description: Discounts to create (at most 100 per request).

discount_activity_period.description: Activity period map (string→string). Key names are undocumented upstream — passed through verbatim.

discount_value.description: Discount value map (string→string). Key names are undocumented upstream — passed through verbatim.

product_id.description: Product id the discount applies to.

name: create_discounts
title: Create discounts
